newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian business migrants invest A$187 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian business migrants invest A$187 mln.

text.p: The Australian government said on Monday business migrants had invested more than A$187 million in Australia since investment-linked visas began in April, 1995.

"Investment-linked migration is attracting skilled business migrants and is just one way of ensuring that Australia continues to benefit from the government's increased emphasis on skilled migration," Immigration Minister Philip Ruddock said in a statement.
Ruddock said that under the investment category, each migrant had to invest between A$750,000 and A$2 million in designated government securities for a minimum of three years.
The Liberal-National government, elected last March, has followed the previous Labor government's push for private sector infrastructure investment, most of which comes from overseas.

In July the government announced it would cut its general migrant intake by nearly 11 percent to 74,000 for fiscal 1996/97, selecting migrants with better English skills, better work skills and greater ability to contribute quickly to national wealth.
